spec.title: Yacht accounts — two native table directions

questions.prompt: A · Compact table — what would you change?
questions.context:
Closest to your Sound settings reference: single-line rows, a quiet header, full-width selection, and a rounded group. The selected account’s folder appears in the bottom bar. Labels and menu-bar choices look like text until you interact with them.

These are browser mockups for a native Swift/AppKit implementation. They use fictional profiles and cannot change Yacht. Try the controls, or use **Comment on preview** to mark a specific area.

questions.prompt: B · Folder paths always visible — what would you change?
questions.context: The same native table treatment, with a second line for every folder path. It is easier to distinguish several profiles at a glance, but rows take more space. The rounded group, subtle striping, plain labels, and quiet menu-bar controls match A.
